name: agent-router-extension
description: Routes GitHub Copilot chat prompts to standard (1x) or advanced (2x+) models based on complexity, with full agentic tool support for file editing, terminal commands, and workspace search.
author: Adnan Okay

chatParticipants.name: router
chatParticipants.description: Routes prompts to standard (1x) or advanced (2x+) Copilot models, with full file-edit and terminal capabilities.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Show routing decision (score, tier, model) without calling a model.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help: usage, commands, flags, available models, and agent tools.

commands.name: boost
commands.description: Expand a simple prompt into a comprehensive one before sending to the model.
commands.sampleRequest: write a python fast api for user auth

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export the current chat session (prompts + responses) to a Markdown file in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_readFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the full text contents of any file in the workspace. Use this to understand existing code before making edits. Paths can be absolute or relative to the workspace root.

path.description: Absolute path, or path relative to the workspace root, of the file to read.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_writeFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with the given content. Use editFile for targeted line-based changes; use writeFile only when replacing the entire file or creating a new one.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path. Parent directories are created automatically.

content.description: The full text content to write to the file.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_editFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply one or more targeted line-range replacements to an existing file. Each edit specifies a 1-based startLine and endLine (inclusive) and the newText to replace that range. Always read the file first to get accurate line numbers. Edits are applied safely via VS Code's WorkspaceEdit API (supports undo).

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to edit.

edits.description: List of edits to apply. Applied in reverse line order so line numbers stay consistent.

startLine.description: 1-based line number where the replacement starts (inclusive).

endLine.description: 1-based line number where the replacement ends (inclusive).

newText.description: Text to replace the line range with. Use empty string to delete lines.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_replaceStringInFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace exactly ONE occurrence of an exact string in a file. The oldString must match exactly (including whitespace and indentation) and must appear only once in the file. Include 3+ lines of surrounding context in oldString to ensure uniqueness. This is the preferred tool for making targeted edits. Shows a diff preview and requires confirmation.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to edit.

oldString.description: The exact literal text to replace. Must match exactly once in the file. Include surrounding context lines for uniqueness.

newString.description: The exact literal text to replace oldString with.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_multiReplaceStringInFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply multiple exact-string replacements across one or more files in a single call. Each replacement specifies a file path, oldString, and newString. Each oldString must match exactly once in its file. More efficient than calling replaceStringInFile multiple times. Requires confirmation.

replacements.description: Array of replacement operations to apply sequentially.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to edit.

oldString.description: The exact literal text to replace. Must match exactly once in the file.

newString.description: The exact literal text to replace oldString with.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_listDirectory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the files and subdirectories inside a directory. Returns each entry prefixed with [file] or [dir]. Use '.' or '' for the workspace root.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative directory path. Defaults to workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_runCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command headlessly and WAIT for it to finish to capture stdout/stderr. ALWAYS use this tool (instead of openTerminal) when running builds, tests, installations, or scripts where you need to verify success or fix errors. This tool lets you read the output and retry if it fails. Commands run in the workspace root by default.

cwd.description: Optional working directory (absolute or workspace-relative). Defaults to workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_searchFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search for a text string across files in the workspace. Returns matching lines with file path and line number. Optionally filter by glob pattern.

include.description: Glob pattern to filter which files to search (e.g. '**/*.ts'). Default: '**/*'.

exclude.description: Glob pattern for files/directories to exclude (e.g. '**/node_modules/**').

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return. Default: 30.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getProblems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return errors and warnings from the VS Code Problems panel. Optionally filter to a specific file path. Use this to check for TypeScript errors, lint issues, etc. after making code changes.

path.description: Optional path filter — only return diagnostics for files whose path contains this string.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_deleteFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a file from the workspace. The file is moved to the system trash so it can be recovered if needed.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to delete.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_renameFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename or move a file or folder to a new path. Use this for refactoring file structure. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_copyFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Duplicate a file to a new path. Useful for scaffolding from templates.

overwrite.description: Overwrite if destination exists. Defaults to false.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_createDirectory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a directory (and any missing parent directories) at the given path.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative directory path to create.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_readFileLines
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a specific line range from a file (1-based, inclusive). Use instead of readFile when the file is large to avoid truncation.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_findAndReplace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Perform find-and-replace across one or more files. Supports plain text or regex. Requires confirmation.

find.description: Text or regex pattern to find.

useRegex.description: Treat 'find' as a regex. Defaults to false.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getSymbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all symbols (functions, classes, variables, etc.) defined in a file using the language server. Returns symbol names, kinds, and line numbers. Use this instead of reading the whole file when you need to understand code structure.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_openFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a file in the VS Code editor, optionally scrolling to a specific line. Use this to direct the user to a relevant location in the codebase.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to open.

line.description: Optional 1-based line number to jump to.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_showDiff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open VS Code's diff editor to compare two text strings side by side. Useful for previewing changes before applying them.

language.description: Language ID for syntax highlighting (e.g. 'typescript'). Defaults to 'plaintext'.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getGitStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run git status and optionally git diff --stat to see uncommitted changes in the workspace.

showDiff.description: If true, also include git diff --stat output.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getExtensionSettings
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read VS Code workspace configuration for a given settings section (e.g. 'editor', 'agentRouter'). Returns all keys and their current values.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_listOpenEditors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all currently open editor tabs in VS Code, including their file paths and which one is active.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getSelectedText
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the text currently selected/highlighted in the active editor, along with the file path and line range.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_insertSnippet
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Insert a text snippet at the current cursor position in the active editor. Supports VS Code snippet syntax (e.g. $0 for cursor placement, $1/$2 for tab stops).

text.description: The text or snippet to insert at the current cursor position.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_runTests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the test suite and capture the output. Defaults to 'npm test'. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getTerminalOutput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace root and capture its stdout and stderr output. Requires confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_fetchUrl
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Perform an HTTP GET request to an external URL and return the response body as text. Useful for fetching documentation, API specs, or resources. Capped at 50KB by default.

url.description: The full URL to fetch (http:// or https://).

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getWorkspaceInfo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the workspace name, root folder path, active file, language ID, cursor position, and whether there are unsaved changes. Call this first when you need context about the user's environment.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getExtensionList
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all installed (non-built-in) VS Code extensions with their IDs, versions, and active status. Optionally filter by name or ID substring.

filter.description: Optional substring to filter results by extension ID or display name.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_showNotification
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Display an info, warning, or error notification popup to the user in VS Code.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_openTerminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open (or reuse) a named terminal panel in VS Code and optionally send a command. VERY IMPORTANT: This is a BLIND fire-and-forget tool. You CANNOT see the output, you CANNOT wait for it to finish, and you CANNOT fix errors. ONLY use this for long-running dev servers (e.g., npm run dev) or if the user explicitly demands a visible terminal. For building docker images, running tests, or installing packages, use runCommand instead so you can capture output and handle errors.

command.description: Optional command to send to the terminal after opening.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_clipboardRead
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the current clipboard contents as text.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_clipboardWrite
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Write text to the clipboard.

text.description: The text to write to the clipboard.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_grepSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fast text or regex search across workspace files. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Use this for exact string or pattern matching. Supports include glob patterns to narrow the search scope.

pattern.description: The text or regex pattern to search for.

isRegex.description: Whether the pattern is a regular expression. Default: false (literal text search).

include.description: Optional glob pattern to filter files (e.g. '*.ts', 'src/**/*.py').

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Default: 30.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_sendToTerminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send text input to an active terminal. The text is sent followed by Enter. Use this to interact with running processes (REPLs, prompts, servers) or to type commands into a visible terminal. Optionally target a specific terminal by name.

text.description: The text to send to the terminal (followed by Enter).

terminalName.description: Optional partial name of the target terminal. If omitted, sends to the active terminal.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_killTerminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Kill (dispose) a terminal by name. If no name is given, kills the active terminal. Use to clean up terminals running servers or long-running processes.

terminalName.description: Optional partial name of the terminal to kill. If omitted, kills the active terminal.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_listCodeUsages
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all usages (references, definitions, implementations) of a code symbol at a specific position in a file. Returns a list of file paths and line numbers where the symbol is referenced. You must provide the file path and the 1-based line and character position of the symbol.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file containing the symbol.

line.description: 1-based line number where the symbol appears.

character.description: 1-based character/column number where the symbol appears.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_renameSymbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename a code symbol across the entire workspace using the language server's rename functionality. This performs a semantics-aware rename that updates all references, imports, and usages. Provide the file, position, and new name.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a file where the symbol appears.

line.description: 1-based line number where the symbol appears.

character.description: 1-based character/column number where the symbol appears.

newName.description: The new name for the symbol.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_runVSCodeCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute any VS Code command by its command ID. This provides access to the full VS Code command palette. Some commands return results. Dangerous commands (quit, reload) are blocked for safety. Common examples: 'editor.action.formatDocument', 'editor.action.organizeImports', 'workbench.action.files.save'.

command.description: The VS Code command ID to execute (e.g. 'editor.action.formatDocument').

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the command.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_viewImage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open an image file in VS Code's built-in image viewer. Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, BMP, and ICO formats. Returns the file size. Use this instead of readFile for image files.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the image file.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_askUser
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the user one or more clarifying questions before proceeding. Each question can be free text or multiple choice (with options). Use this when the user's intent is ambiguous, when you need a preference, or when confirmation is needed before a potentially destructive action. Returns the user's answers.

questions.description: List of questions to ask the user.

options.description: Optional list of choices. If provided, shows as a dropdown. If omitted, shows a free text input.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_memory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Persistent notes system for storing and retrieving information across conversations. Supports two scopes: 'global' (persists across all workspaces) and 'workspace' (scoped to the current project). Actions: 'list' (show all notes), 'read' (get a note by key), 'write' (create/update a note), 'delete' (remove a note). Use this to remember user preferences, project conventions, or task context.

action.description: The operation: read, write, list, or delete.

scope.description: Storage scope. 'global' persists across all workspaces, 'workspace' is project-scoped. Default: 'global'.

key.description: The note key/name. Required for read, write, delete.

content.description: The note content. Required for write.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_todoList
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage a task tracking list for multi-step work. Actions: 'get' (view current list), 'set' (replace entire list with new items), 'update' (change a single item's status by id), 'clear' (remove all items). Each item has an id, title, and status (not-started, in-progress, completed). Use this to plan and track progress on complex tasks.

action.description: The operation: get, set, update, or clear.

items.description: Full todo list (for 'set' action). Each item needs id, title, status.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_runSubAgent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Launch a separate LLM call to handle a subtask autonomously. The sub-agent runs with a fresh context and returns its result. Use this for: researching a question while continuing your main task, delegating a self-contained subtask (e.g. 'summarize this file', 'generate test cases'), or getting a second opinion. The sub-agent does NOT have access to tools — it's a pure text completion. Provide a clear, detailed task description.

task.description: Detailed description of the subtask for the sub-agent to complete.

systemPrompt.description: Optional custom system prompt. Default: general helpful assistant.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_terminalLastCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the last executed command from a terminal, including its command line, exit code, and output. Uses VS Code's shell integration API. Optionally specify a terminal by name.

terminalName.description: Optional partial name of the terminal. If omitted, returns from all terminals.

count.description: Number of recent commands to return. Default: 1. Max: 20.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_createNotebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) file with optional initial cells. Each cell has a language ('python', 'markdown', etc.) and content. The notebook is created and opened in VS Code.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path for the new .ipynb file.

cells.description: Optional initial cells. Defaults to one empty Python cell.

content.description: Cell source code or markdown content.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_runNotebookCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute a specific code cell in a Jupyter notebook by its 1-based index. Returns the cell output after execution. Only code cells can be executed (not markdown). Optionally provide a notebook path, or it uses the active notebook.

path.description: Optional notebook path. If omitted, uses the active notebook.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_readNotebookCellOutput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the output of a specific notebook cell by its 1-based index. Returns text output, error tracebacks, image descriptions, etc. Use this to check results of previously executed cells without re-running them.

path.description: Optional notebook path. If omitted, uses the active notebook.

cellIndex.description: 1-based cell index to read output from.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_editNotebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit cells in a Jupyter notebook. Supports insert, replace, and delete operations on cells by 1-based index. Each edit specifies an action, cellIndex, and optionally language and content. Edits are applied via VS Code's WorkspaceEdit API (supports undo).

path.description: Optional notebook path. If omitted, uses the active notebook.

edits.description: List of cell edits to apply.

action.description: insert: add cell at index, replace: swap cell content, delete: remove cell.

languageModelTools.name: agent-router_getNotebookSummary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a summary of a Jupyter notebook including its cells, types, languages, line counts, and whether each cell has output. Use this to understand notebook structure before editing or running cells.

path.description: Optional notebook path. If omitted, uses the active notebook.

agentRouter.freeThreshold.description: Complexity score (0-100) threshold. If a prompt scores higher than this, it is routed to an advanced (2x+) model. Scores at or below this go to a standard (1x) model.

agentRouter.hybridAgentMode.description: When using an advanced model, automatically switch to a standard (1x) model for intermediate agent tool calls to save token budget.

agentRouter.agentMode.description: When enabled, @router uses the full agentic loop with tool-calling (file edits, terminal commands, etc.). When disabled, it routes and answers without tools.

agentRouter.usageRefreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh premium request usage data from the GitHub Copilot API.

agentRouter.githubEnterpriseUrl.description: Base URL for GitHub Enterprise (e.g. https://company.ghe.com). When set, the extension will also attempt to authenticate via the GitHub Enterprise provider. Leave empty to use github.com only.

agentRouter.routingRules.description: Custom routing rules. Each rule is an object with a 'pattern' (regex string to match against the prompt) and 'model' (model name to route to) or 'tier' ('standard' or 'advanced'). Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against the prompt text.

model.description: Model name to route to when pattern matches (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5.0').

tier.description: Tier to route to when pattern matches (ignored if 'model' is set).
